labels.name: Vertebral body
labels.function: Weight-bearing block; anterior wedge collapse in osteoporosis

labels.name: Annulus fibrosus
labels.function: Outer ring of the disc; thin posterolaterally

labels.name: Nucleus pulposus
labels.function: Gelatinous core; dehydrates with age and can herniate

labels.name: Anterior longitudinal ligament
labels.function: Runs on the front of the bodies; limits hyperextension

labels.name: Posterior longitudinal ligament
labels.function: Lines the back of the bodies in the canal; limits hyperflexion

labels.name: Spinal cord
labels.function: Compression causes myelopathy: UMN signs below the lesion

labels.name: Ligamentum flavum
labels.function: Connects adjacent laminae; thickening narrows the canal

labels.name: Spinous process
labels.function: Palpable midline projection at the back of the arch

labels.name: Interspinous ligament
labels.function: Fills the gap between neighboring posterior processes

labels.name: Supraspinous ligament
labels.function: Continuous band over the tips of the posterior processes

labels.name: Annulus fibrosus
labels.function: Fibrocartilage ring; weakest at its back corners

labels.name: Herniated nucleus pulposus
labels.function: Gel extruded posterolaterally; causes radicular pain

labels.name: Descending (lower) nerve root
labels.function: Root hit by this herniation: L4-L5 disc compresses L5

labels.name: Exiting (upper) nerve root
labels.function: Already left above the disc, so usually spared

labels.name: Intervertebral foramen
labels.function: Exit window for the spinal nerve; narrowed in stenosis

labels.name: Lateral recess
labels.function: Gutter where the lower root descends past the disc

labels.name: Vertebral canal
labels.function: Central narrowing here gives neurogenic claudication

labels.name: Facet joint
labels.function: Synovial joint of articular processes; wears in spondylosis

labels.name: Spinous process
labels.function: Midline posterior projection of the arch

labels.name: Osteophyte
labels.function: Spur of age-related degeneration; can crowd neural spaces

labels.name: Intervertebral disc
labels.function: Shock absorber; loses height and turgor with age

labels.name: Pedicle
labels.function: Its notches above and below bound the nerve exit window

labels.name: Intervertebral foramen
labels.function: Bony window shared by two levels for a nerve to exit

labels.name: Spinal nerve
labels.function: Compression gives dermatomal pain and myotomal weakness

labels.name: Facet joint
labels.function: Paired joint of articular processes; worn in degenerative slip

labels.name: Pars interarticularis defect
labels.function: Stress fracture from repeated extension; Scotty dog collar

labels.name: Spondylolisthesis
labels.function: Forward displacement of a vertebra over the one below
